lines.zh: 蹄声在林地间一下一下。
lines.en: Hooves sound through the woods, one beat at a time.

lines.zh: 它踩着苔石，往林深处走。
lines.en: It steps on mossy stones toward the deep woods.
It leans on the rock wall with eyes closed.

lines.zh: 指爪无意识地敲着地面。
lines.en: Its claws tap the ground without thinking.

lines.zh: 它歪头听着远处的回声。
lines.en: It tilts its head toward a distant echo.

lines.zh: 微光在它身侧散开又收拢。
lines.en: Faint light spreads from its side and gathers again.

lines.zh: 它把战利品一件件摆开。
lines.en: It lays out its spoils one by one.

lines.zh: 一段古老的调子在它喉间滚。
lines.en: An old tune rolls in its throat.

lines.zh: 我从林叶缝隙里打量你。
lines.en: I study you through a gap in the leaves.

lines.zh: 它半睁着眼，先看你的手。
lines.en: Half-lidded, it looks at your hands first.

lines.zh: 目光从你的武器移到脸上。
lines.en: Its gaze moves from your weapon to your face.
It does not move, only turns its side to you.

lines.zh: 它把你从头到脚看了一遍。
lines.en: It looks you over from head to foot.

lines.zh: 我好饿，我的身体很虚弱！
听到美食的声音，它的眼中闪过贪婪。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with greed at the sound of food.

lines.zh: 它用蹄子刨开雪地，露出美味的根茎。
lines.en: It digs through the snow for tasty roots.

lines.zh: 它盯着树叶，渴望填饱肚子。
lines.en: Its eyes are on the leaves, craving a meal.

lines.zh: 它张开大嘴，享受着美味的果实。
lines.en: It opens its mouth wide, savoring the fruit.

lines.zh: 它发出咕噜声，表示对食物的满意。
lines.en: It grumbles contentedly at the food.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，它啃食着冰封的浆果。
lines.en: In the cold, it munches on frozen berries.

lines.zh: 它用蹄子拍打着地上的雪，寻找美味。
lines.en: It taps the snow with its hooves, searching for treats.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在雪中寻找隐藏的坚果。
lines.en: Its eyes search the snow for hidden nuts.

lines.zh: 它咀嚼着树叶，享受森林的馈赠。
lines.en: It chews on the leaves, savoring the forest's bounty.

lines.zh: 它在树下寻找美味的浆果。
lines.en: It searches under the trees for tasty berries.

lines.zh: 两头托莫在雪地里撞个满怀。
lines.en: Two Tomos collide in the snow.

lines.zh: 它试图用肩膀撞开入侵者。
lines.en: It uses its shoulder to push the intruder away.

lines.zh: 托莫的蹄子在雪中发出清脆的声音。
lines.en: Its hooves make a crisp sound in the snow.

lines.zh: 两只托莫为了领地互撞。
它用角顶开试图靠近的玩家。
lines.en: It uses its horns to push back the player.

lines.zh: 托莫发出低沉的吼声，警告入侵者。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl, warning the intruder.

lines.zh: 它用蹄子踢向逼近的敌对生物。
lines.en: It kicks with its hooves at the approaching mob.

lines.zh: 托莫在雪地上互相顶撞。
lines.en: Two Tomos collide in the snow.

lines.zh: 它用身体撞击试图靠近的小生物。
lines.en: It uses its body to push back small mobs.
The Tomos clash with their horns.

lines.zh: 我用蹄子刨出一小块空地。
lines.en: I paw out a small clearing with my hooves.

lines.zh: 它用蹄子轻轻触碰对方。
lines.en: It gently touches the other with its hooves.
It makes a low mating call.

lines.zh: 它用鼻子轻轻触碰对方。
lines.en: It gently touches the other with its nose.

lines.zh: 它展示着吸引对方的姿势。
lines.en: It displays a posture to attract the other.
It strokes the other with its hooves.
It gently touches the other with its horns.

lines.zh: 吱吱叫着抓起一簇草药
lines.en: Squeals as it grabs some herbs

lines.zh: 啃食着掉落的强化魔法肉
在洞穴中寻找阿帕拉契亚之魂
lines.en: Scours for Appalachia Souls in caves

lines.zh: 用嘶哑的声音喊着同类名字
lines.en: Groans the name of its kind

lines.zh: 啃食腐烂的树叶以恢复生命力
lines.en: Eats rotten leaves to regain stamina

lines.zh: 在魔法森林里捡起一缕魔力
lines.en: Gathers a strand of magic from the forest

lines.zh: 在草地上咀嚼着鲜美的草药
lines.en: Chews on the tasty herbs in the grass

lines.zh: 从岩石缝隙中捡起一小块魔石
lines.en: Picks up a small piece of magic stone

lines.zh: 在地面上捡起一束发光的蘑菇
lines.en: Gathers glowing mushrooms from the ground

lines.zh: 捡起地上的松果，啃上几口
lines.en: Picks up a pine cone and gnaws on it
Takes note of the prey’s scent

lines.zh: 注意到了地面上的足迹

lines.en: Discovers a player in the distance

lines.zh: 感应到周围的魔法波动
注意到了天空中的异常
lines.en: Notices something unusual in the sky

lines.zh: 感知到了地面下的动静
lines.en: Feels the movement beneath the ground

lines.zh: 锁定了一个闪烁的光点
捕捉到了一个快速移动的身影
lines.en: Catches the quick movement of a shadow

lines.zh: 它朝林子里低叫了一声。
lines.en: It gives a low call into the woods.

lines.zh: 同类的回应从三处传来。
lines.en: Answers come back from three directions.

lines.zh: 向目标发出一道魔法之箭
lines.en: Fires a magic arrow at the target
Spits a ball of fire from its mouth
Attacks the player with its claws
Whips its tail at the player
Bursts out of the ground to attack
Spreads its wings and dives at the player

lines.zh: 向玩家投掷一块魔法岩石
lines.en: Throws a magic rock at the player
It slips behind the stone pillar.
A dim glow rises in its palm.
It counts where its kin stand.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的夜晚现身！

lines.en: I rise up from behind the mossy stone.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的雾气里多了个影子。
lines.en: A shadow joins the mist of Apalachia.

lines.zh: 它从倒下的树干下站起。
lines.en: It rises from beneath a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 林地深处传来一声长哨。
lines.en: A long whistle sounds deep in the woods.
Rubble rolls down, and it appears.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的魂，被烧焦了。

lines.en: The Apalachia slopes are too steep.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的草地被炸出坑。

lines.en: The arrow's fletching still quivers in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的天也会打雷。
